rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The surah urges serious observance of Friday prayer; honoring this great rite benefits people in this world and the next.
rows.anchor: بيان غرض السورة هو الحث البالغ على الاهتمام بأمر صلاة الجمعة والقيام بواجب أمرها فهي من شعائر الله المعظمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The surah was revealed in Medina.
rows.anchor: وذلك آية عدم تحملهم ما حملوا من معارف كتاب الله وأحكامه، والسورة مدنية

words: يسبح لله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tasbih means declaring something free of impurity and of defects or deficiencies.
rows.anchor: التسبيح تنزيه الشيء ونسبته إلى الطهارة والنزاهة من العيوب والنقائص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The present tense conveys continuous glorification.
rows.anchor: والتعبير بالمضارع للدلالة على الاستمرار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Malik denotes exclusive authority to govern the social order.
rows.anchor: والملك هو الاختصاص بالحكم في نظام المجتمع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Quddus intensifies the sense of purity and freedom from impurity.
rows.anchor: والقدوس مبالغة في القدس وهو النزاهة والطهارة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Aziz is the one whom no victor can overcome.
rows.anchor: والعزيز هو الذي لا يغلبه غالب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Hakim acts with precision, never from ignorance or arbitrarily.
rows.anchor: والحكيم هو المتقن فعله فلا يفعل عن جهل أو جزاف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opening glorification lays a rational foundation for the mission that perfects, guides, and makes people happy after their manifest error.
rows.anchor: من بعثة الرسول لتكميل الناس وإسعادهم وهدايتهم بعد إذ كانوا في ضلال مبين

words: يسبح لله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Heavenly and earthly beings glorify God through their deficiencies and needs, which only He can complete and satisfy.
rows.anchor: فما من نقيصة أو حاجة إلا وهو المرجو في تمامها وقضائها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As sovereign, God may govern creation and legislate for His servants, who must obey Him.
rows.anchor: فله أن يحكم في نظام التكوين بين خلقة بما شاء، وفي نظام التشريع في عباده بما أراد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God legislates without need; worship completes no deficiency in Him because He is free of every need and defect.
rows.anchor: لم يكن ذلك منه لحاجة إلى تعبيدهم ونقص فيه يتممه بعبادتهم لأنه قدوس منزه عن كل نقص وحاجة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People's refusal to obey cannot frustrate God's will, since He cannot be overcome.
rows.anchor: لم يكن ذلك تعجيزا منهم له تعالى لأنه العزيز لا يغلبه فيما يريده غالب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's legislation is not futile: His acts serve wise interests and the good of people in this life and the next.
rows.anchor: لا يفعل ما يفعل إلا لمصلحة ولا يريد منهم ما يريد إلا لنفع يعود إليهم وخير ينالونه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ummiyyin means people who cannot read or write.
rows.anchor: الأميون جمع أمي وهو الذي لا يقرأ ولا يكتب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The likely referent is the Arabs, since few among them could read or write; Muhammad was one of their kind, while also being sent to all humanity.
rows.anchor: المراد بهم - كما قيل - العرب لقلة من كان منهم يقرأ ويكتب وقد كان الرسول صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم منهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The proposal that ummiyyin means non-Jews or other People of the Book does not fit, since the Prophet's message was not limited in that way.
rows.anchor: وفيه أنه لا يناسب قوله في ذيل الآية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The proposal that it means Meccans, named for Mecca as Umm al-Qura, is unsuitable for a Medinan surah and its pronoun reference.
rows.anchor: وفيه أنه لا يناسب كون السورة مدنية لإيهامه كون ضمير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being from the ummiyyin and initially sent among them is compatible with being sent to them and to all other peoples.
rows.anchor: ولا منافاة بين كونه صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم من الأميين مبعوثا فيهم وبين كونه مبعوثا إليهم وإلى غيرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet first recited and taught in Arabic as the initial stage of his mission; after it gained stability he addressed Jews, Christians, Magians, and rulers.
rows.anchor: ولذا لما استقرت الدعوة بعض الاستقرار أخذ صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم يدعو اليهود والنصارى والمجوس وكاتب العظماء والملوك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham and Ishmael's prayer covers all descendants of Ishmael, including Mudar Arabs beyond Mecca, without limiting the Prophet's mission to them alone.
rows.anchor: تشمل جميع آل إسماعيل من عرب مضر أعم من أهل مكة وغيرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet recites the verses of the Book despite being unlettered; this phrase describes the messenger.
rows.anchor: أي آيات كتابه مع كونه أميا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tazkiya derives from growth that is wholesome, good, and blessed; the Prophet cultivates people in that way.
rows.anchor: التزكية تفعيل من الزكاة بمعنى النمو الصالح الذي يلازم الخير والبركة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By habituating people to virtuous character and good deeds, the Prophet perfects their humanity so they live and die happy.
rows.anchor: فتزكيته لهم تنميته لهم نماء صالحا بتعويدهم الأخلاق الفاضلة والأعمال الصالحة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Teaching the Book means explaining the wording of its verses and interpreting what is difficult in them.
rows.anchor: وتعليم الكتاب بيان ألفاظ آياته وتفسير ما أشكل من ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Teaching wisdom means teaching the true knowledge contained in the Qur'an.
rows.anchor: ويقابله تعليم الحكمة وهي المعارف الحقيقية التي يتضمنها القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One suggested explanation is that calling the Qur'an both verses and Book highlights each title as a blessing by which God favors people.
rows.anchor: والتعبير عن القرآن تارة بالآيات وتارة بالكتاب للدلالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Purification precedes teaching here because the verse describes the Prophet's education of believers, where ethical formation comes before true sciences.
rows.anchor: لأن هذه الآية تصف تربيته صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم لمؤمني أمته، والتزكية مقدمة في مقام التربية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham's prayer orders knowledge before purification because it asks for these qualities to be realized, and knowledge ranks earlier and higher than conduct and morals.
rows.anchor: وأما ما في دعوة إبراهيم عليه السلام فإنها دعاء وسؤال أن يتحقق في ذريته هذه الزكاة والعلم بالكتاب والحكمة

words: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the phrase about their former error, in is the lightened form of the emphatic particle.
rows.anchor: مخففة من الثقيلة والمراد أنهم كانوا من قبل بعثة الرسول

words: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They were plainly astray before the Messenger's mission; the verse is praise following glorification and expresses gratitude for divine favor.
rows.anchor: والآية تحميد بعد تسبيح ومسوقة للامتنان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Others who have not yet joined are coordinated with the ummiyyin; the pronoun refers to them and min is partitive.
rows.anchor: عطف على الأميين وضمير { منهم } راجع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mission extends to other people among the ummiyyin who had not yet joined the earlier recipients.
rows.anchor: والمعنى بعث في الأميين وفي آخرين منهم لم يلحقوا بهم بعد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here al-Aziz means unconquerable and al-Hakim means that God's acts are never futile or arbitrary.
rows.anchor: وهو العزيز الذي لا يغلب في إرادته الحكيم الذي لا يلغو ولا يجازف في فعله

rows.speaker: المفسرون
rows.claim: The exegetes take the distant demonstrative to magnify the Prophet's mission, recitation, purification, and teaching as God's favor bestowed on Muhammad.
rows.anchor: والله ذو الفضل العظيم كذا قال المفسرون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, that may refer to the mission together with its sender and recipients: God chose Muhammad and his community for this favor.
rows.anchor: ومن الممكن أن تكون الإشارة بذلك إلى البعث بما له من النسبة إلى أطرافه من المرسل والمرسل إليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse and the two preceding verses are framed as a statement of God's favor.
rows.anchor: والآية والآيتان قبلها أعني قوله

rows.speaker: الراغب
rows.claim: Al-Raghib explains safar as uncovering, used for things such as removing a turban or veil; sifr with kasra means a book that reveals truths.
rows.anchor: قال الراغب السفر - بالفتح فالسكون - كشف الغطاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being loaded with the Torah means being taught it, while carrying it means putting it into practice, as context and the verse's conclusion indicate.
rows.anchor: والمراد بتحميل التوراة تعليمها، والمراد بحملها العمل بها على ما يؤيده السياق ويشهد به ما في ذيل الآية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people meant are the Jews, taught the Torah's knowledge and laws through Moses but abandoning them without acting on them.
rows.anchor: والمراد بالذين حملوا التوراة ثم لم يحملوها اليهود الذين أنزل الله التوراة على رسولهم موسى عليه السلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The donkey carrying books understands none of their truths and receives only the burden, illustrating the Torah's unpracticed knowledge.
rows.anchor: فلا يبقى له من حملها إلا التعب بتحمل ثقلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An unattributed report likens speaking during the Friday sermon to a donkey bearing books and says that telling the speaker to listen forfeits Friday prayer; the author says it supports his proposed connection.
rows.anchor: من تكلم يوم الجمعة والإمام يخطب فهو كالحمار يحمل أسفارا

rows.speaker: تفسير القمي
rows.claim: A report in Tafsir al-Qummi says the Torah states that God's friends wish for death.
rows.anchor: وفي تفسير القمي في قوله تعالى { قل يا أيها الذين هادوا } الآية، قال إن في التوراة مكتوب أولياء الله يتمنون الموت

rows.speaker: أبو عبد الله
rows.claim: In al-Kafi, Abu Abdillah answers a question about disliking death: people built up worldly life and ruined the next, so dread moving from habitation to ruin; no grading is stated.
rows.anchor: عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام قال جاء رجل إلى أبي ذر فقال يا أبا ذر ما لنا نكره الموت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Different communities orient themselves along distinct paths, as the Qur'an says that each has a direction toward which it turns.
rows.anchor: فلكل وجهة هو موليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The nonreligious person who submits to matter turns away from preparing for eternal life and pursues worldly concerns.
rows.anchor: وغير الملي الخاضع للمادة يلوي إلى خلاف ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A religious person takes eternal life into account in their efforts, prepares for permanence, and turns toward God.
rows.anchor: الملي يراعي في مساعيه جانب ما يراه لنفسه من الحياة الخالدة المؤبدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ways of life differ among religious and nonreligious communities and among religious traditions because their views of existence differ.
rows.anchor: ويختلف سنن هؤلاء باختلافهم أنفسهم فيما بينهم كاختلاف سنن الوثنيين من البرهميين والبوذيين وغيرهم والمليين من المجوسية والكليمية والمسيحية والمسلمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A religious person prepares for lasting life and turns to God without excessive concern for transient attractions; a materialist follows the opposite course.
rows.anchor: الملي يراعي في مساعيه جانب ما يراه لنفسه من الحياة الخالدة المؤبدة ويذعن من الآراء بما يناسب ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because humans are materially entangled with apparent causes, they imagine worldly life and its possessions are the ultimate reality, and treat desired immediate benefits as absolute good.
rows.anchor: أن الأصالة لحياته الدنيوية المنقطعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People outside religion act on materialist beliefs; religious adherents may do so in practice while professing the opposite, producing an inner conflict like the Qur'anic parable.
rows.anchor: فمن كان منهم من غير أهل الملة جرى على هذه الآراء ولا خبر عنده عما وراء ذلك، ومن كان منهم من أهل الملة جرى عليها عملا وهو معترف بخلافها قولا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fitrah's cognition and inclinations move toward real perfection and happiness, grounding the true beliefs and actions taught by religion.
rows.anchor: ومن المعلوم أن الفطرة لا تهتدي علما ولا تميل عملا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fitrah's fundamental beliefs about origin and return, derived beliefs, and actions are true because they serve real human happiness.
rows.anchor: فما تهتدي إليه من الاعتقادات الأصلية في المبدأ والمعاد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Truth is a belief matching reality and accompanied by right guidance without error; the Qur'an calls the religion and its guidance the religion of truth and guidance to truth.
rows.anchor: وليس الحق إلا الرأي والاعتقاد الذي يطابقه الواقع ويلازمه الرشد من غير غي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wisdom is sound judgment that admits no falsehood and yields benefit without harm.
rows.anchor: الرأي الذي أحكم في صدقه فلا يتخلله كذب، وفي نفعه فلا يعقبه ضرر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Revelation joins the Book and wisdom, the Qur'an is called wise, and the Messenger is repeatedly described as teaching wisdom.
rows.anchor: ووصف كلامه المنزل بها فقال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's Qur'anic teaching clarifies true beliefs about existence and human nature, and the derivative beliefs that guide human purposes and actions.
rows.anchor: من تعليم الحكمة وشأنه بيان ما هو الحق في أصول الاعتقادات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an corrects the view that worldly life is all there is by teaching that worldly life is play while the afterlife is true life.
rows.anchor: والقرآن ينبههم بقوله وما هذه الحياة الدنيا إلا لهو ولعب وإن الدار الآخرة لهي الحيوان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Against attributing events to night and day, the Qur'an teaches that creation and command belong to God and judgment is His alone.
rows.anchor:
ألا له الخلق والأمر
الأعراف 54، وقوله
إن الحكم إلا لله
يوسف 40، وغير ذلك من آيات الحكمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an denies that human beings will independently, and that they can guide whom they wish without God.
rows.anchor:
ويرون أن لهم أن يطيعوا ويعصوا ويهدوا ويهتدوا والقرآن ينبئهم بقوله
إنك لا تهدي من أحببت ولكن الله يهدي من يشاء
القصص 56

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an rejects the belief that people possess independent strength, saying all strength is God's.
rows.anchor:
ويرون أن لهم قوة والقرآن ينكر ذلك بقوله
أن القوة لله جميعا
البقرة 165

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an rejects wealth and allies as sources of honor, declaring that honor belongs to God, His Messenger, and believers.
rows.anchor:
القرآن يحكم بخلافه بقوله
أيبتغون عندهم العزة إن العزة لله جميعا
النساء 139. وقوله
ولله العزة ولرسوله وللمؤمنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Against treating martyrdom as death and extinction, the Qur'an says those killed in God's way are alive, though people do not perceive it.
rows.anchor: والقرآن يعده حياة إذ يقول ولا تقولوا لمن يقتل في سبيل الله أموات بل أحياء ولكن لا تشعرون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These teachings are wisdom by which the Prophet calls people, believers counsel one another to truth, and God grants great good to the wise.
rows.anchor: إلى غير ذلك من التعاليم القرآنية التي أمر النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم أن يدعو بها الناس قال ادع إلى سبيل ربك بالحكمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an recasts people's knowledge and conduct into a new form, giving them a life that never ends.
rows.anchor: فالقرآن بالحقيقة يقلب الإنسان في قالب من حيث العلم والعمل حديث ويصوغه صوغا جديدا فيحيى حياة لا يتعقبها موت أبدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He rejects the claim that Qur'anic exegesis is merely recitation and that close study of its meanings is forbidden interpretation.
rows.anchor: ومما تقدم يتبين فساد قول من قال إن تفسير القرآن تلاوته، وإن التعمق في مداليل آيات القرآن من التأويل الممنوع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being presented means being shown before God for judgment, like a seller spreading goods before a buyer.
rows.anchor: والعرض إراءة البائع سلعته للمشتري ببسطها بين يديه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On that day people's beliefs and deeds are exposed so fully that nothing remains hidden: the unseen becomes witnessed and secrets public.
rows.anchor: إبراز ما عند الإنسان من اعتقاد وعمل إبرازا لا يخفى معه عقيدة خافية ولا فعلة خافية وذلك بتبدل الغيب شهادة والسر علنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's exclusive dominion, command, and knowledge, and creation's exposure before Him, are always true; the Day makes them unmistakably manifest.
rows.anchor: كل ذلك دائمية الثبوت له تعالى، وإنما المراد ظهور هذه الحقائق يومئذ ظهورا لا ستر عليه ولا مرية فيه

rows.speaker: المجمع
rows.claim: Al-Majmaʿ describes هاؤم as a plural imperative equivalent to هاكم and lists singular, dual, masculine plural, and feminine forms in Hijaz usage.
rows.anchor: قال في المجمع هاؤم أمر للجماعة بمنزلة هاكم، تقول للواحد هاء يا رجل، وللاثنين هاؤما يا رجلان

rows.speaker: المجمع
rows.claim: Al-Majmaʿ reports that Tamim and Qays use alternative forms, and that some Arabs replace the hamza with kaf in forms such as هاك.
rows.anchor: هذه لغة أهل الحجاز. وتميم وقيس يقولون هاء يا رجل مثل قول أهل الحجاز، وللاثنين هاءآ، وللجماعة هاؤا

rows.speaker: المجمع
rows.claim: The imperative means take or receive and is used as a command, not a prohibition.
rows.anchor: ومعناه خذ وتناول، ويؤمر بها ولا ينهى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Verse 19 and what follows through the description of the sinners detail how people's conditions differ in happiness and misery on that day.
rows.anchor: بيان تفصيلي لاختلاف حال الناس يومئذ من حيث السعادة والشقاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah argues that people know God created them and their ordered world; as creator He owns and governs it, so He alone is Lord and due worship.
rows.anchor: وأنتم تعلمون أنه تعالى خلقكم وخلق العالم الذي تعيشون فيه طورا من الخلق لا ينفك عن هذا النظام الجاري فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Recognizing God's active attributes, including creation, provision, and mercy, gives people grounds to turn to Him in worship.
rows.anchor: فإنا نعرفه بصفاته الكريمة من الخلق والرزق والرحمة وسائر صفاته الفعلية فلنا أن نتوجه إليه بما نعرفه من صفاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase about creating people in stages is circumstantial, modifying the subject of لا ترجون.
rows.anchor: حال من فاعل { لا ترجون }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Atwar is plural of طور, meaning a thing's stage, limit, or condition.
rows.anchor: والأطوار جمع طور وهو حد الشيء وحاله التي هو عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God forms each person through successive stages from dust, fluid, clot, morsel, embryo, child, youth, and old age, and creates human groups with varied traits.
rows.anchor: فأنشأ الواحد منكم ترابا ثم نطفة ثم علقة ثم مضغة ثم جنينا ثم طفلا ثم شابا ثم شيخا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The stages and human differences in sex, color, form, strength, and weakness display divine governance and establish God as Lord.
rows.anchor: وأنشأ جمعكم مختلفة الأفراد في الذكورة والأنوثة والألوان والهيآت والقوة والضعف إلى غير ذلك، وهل هذا إلا التدبير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The seven heavens being طباق may mean that they are stacked one above another or that they resemble and correspond to each other.
rows.anchor: مطابقة السماوات السبع بعضها لبعض كون بعضها فوق بعض أو تطابقهن وتماثلهن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seeing the heavens means knowing them; the argument assumes Noah's people accepted that there were seven heavens.
rows.anchor: يدل على أنهم كانوا يرون كونها سبعا ويسلمون ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah's mention of the seven heavens indicates that this teaching was transmitted among prophets from ancient times.
rows.anchor: فوقوع حديث السماوات السبع في كلام نوح دليل على كونه مأثورا من الأنبياء عليهم السلام من أقدم العهود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sun and moon passages present God's governance and blessings to humanity: the sun lights the world, while the moon illuminates Earth with reflected sunlight rather than its own lamp-like light.
rows.anchor: وكون القمر نورا هو كونه منورا لأرضنا بنور مكتسب من الشمس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The moon being in the heavens means within their domain, even if it is in only one, as one well in a group of houses may be said to be in them all.
rows.anchor: فالمراد به كما قيل كونه في حيزهن وإن كان في واحدة منها كما تقول إن في هذه الدور لبئرا وإن كانت في واحدة منها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse speaks literally: human bodies arise from specially combined earthly elements that nourish, grow, and reproduce, which is the reality of plant growth.
rows.anchor: فالكلام مسوق سوق الحقيقة من غير تشبيه واستعارة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Returning people to Earth means death and burial; bringing them out means resurrection for judgment.
rows.anchor: الإعادة فيها بالإماتة والإقبار، والإخراج للجزاء يوم القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The waw rather than ثم before bringing people out hints that burial and emergence form one process, with return preceding emergence.
rows.anchor: إيماء إلى أن الاعادة والإخراج كالصنع الواحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People are in the abode of truth during their return and emergence, just as worldly life is the abode of delusion.
rows.anchor: والانسان في حالتي الاعادة والإخراج في دار الحق كما أنه في الدنيا في دار الغرور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made Earth like a spread carpet so people can move easily from place to place and travel across regions.
rows.anchor: أي كالبساط يسهل لكم التقلب من جانب إلى جانب، والانتقال من قطر إلى قطر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Subul means paths; fijaj means broad roads, or, according to another view, routes between mountains.
rows.anchor: السبل جمع سبيل بمعنى الطريق والفجاج جمع فج بمعنى الطريق الواسعة، وقيل الطريق الواقعة بين الجبلين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah returns to complaining after recounting his detailed preaching, just as his earlier complaint followed his summary that he called his people night and day.
rows.anchor: رجوع منه عليه السلام إلى شكواه من قومه إلى ربه بعد ما ذكر تفصيل دعوته لهم وما ألقاه من القول إليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wealthy chiefs of Noah's people obstructed him and incited others to oppose and harm him.
rows.anchor: وفي الآية دلالة على أن العظماء المترفين من قومه عليه السلام كانوا يصدون الناس عنه ويحرضونهم على مخالفته وإيذائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Though wealth and children are blessings, they increased the chiefs only in disbelief and loss of God's mercy because they failed to give thanks.
rows.anchor: أن المال والولد اللذين هما من نعمك وكان يجب عليهم شكرهما لم يزيداهم إلا كفرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kibaar is an intensive form derived from kibr, greatness.
rows.anchor: الكبار اسم مبالغة من الكبر

words: وَدًّۭا وَلَا سُوَاعًۭا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًۭا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The chiefs urged people to keep worshipping their gods and singled out five especially cherished idols: Wadd, Suwa, Yaghuth, Yaquq, and Nasr.
rows.anchor: وود وسواع ويغوث ويعوق ونسر خمس من آلهتهم لهم اهتمام تام بعبادتهن ولذا خصوها بالذكر

words: وَدًّۭا وَلَا سُوَاعًۭا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًۭا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He tentatively suggests that Wadd is introduced and Suwa and Yaghuth receive emphatic negation because they mattered more to the people than Yaquq and Nasr.
rows.anchor: ولعل تصدير ود وذكر سواع ويغوث بلا المؤكدة للنفي لكونها أعظم أمرا عندهم من يعوق ونسر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pronoun in أضلوا refers to the followed chiefs, as confirmed by the preceding account of their plotting and commands.
rows.anchor: للرؤساء المتبوعين ويتأيد به أنهم هم المحدث عنهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A second proposed referent is the idols themselves as those who mislead, but the author considers this unlikely.
rows.anchor: وقيل الضمير للأصنام فهم المضلون، ولا يخلو من بعد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah asks for retributive misguidance in response to wrongdoing, not initial error, and the prayer is followed by his request for their destruction.
rows.anchor: والمراد به الضلال مجازاة دون الضلال الابتدائي فهو دعاء منه أن يجازيهم الله بكفرهم وفسقهم
